message.content:
Line 10 writes the NUL terminator at `dst[n]`, but the code only verifies that `n` bytes are available in the XDR stream. It never verifies that the destination slice has room for `n + 1` bytes. The primary bug is introduced at the write of the terminator.

Answer: 10
